name: Aluminium Fluoride (AlF3): Smelter Flux Import Substitution from Fertiliser Fluorine By-Product
scope: India's aluminium fluoride (AlF3) supply chain: the smelter build-out driving flux demand, the fertiliser FSA by-product route, and listed makers, entrants and smelter buyers.

summary.one_line: NALCO extended its AlF3 JV/partner EoI to 30 Oct 2026. China's benchmark AlF3 price rose more than 1,000 yuan/t to 12,600-13,000 yuan/t on October contracts. Alufluoride shares are about 22% off their high ahead of Q2 FY27 results that will show whether FSA-constrained volumes have recovered.
key_points: This week: NALCO extended the deadline for its AlF3, CPC and coal-tar-pitch EoIs from 12 Oct to 30 Oct 2026, through notices published 12 Oct (S21). No respondents or proposal counts have been disclosed (S21). Last week's edition treated the EoI as closed; it is still open.

This week: China's benchmark AlF3 producers settled October long-term contracts more than 1,000 yuan/t higher. SMM quoted mainstream AlF3 at 12,600-13,000 yuan/t on 22 Oct 2026, against 11,500-12,500 yuan/t on 24 Sep (S16)(S22). Producers are still at low loads and mostly loss-making, with fluorite firm at 3,350-3,850 yuan/t (S22).

AlF3 is the cryolite-bath flux used in aluminium electrolysis (S10). Alufluoride puts consumption at 14-20 kg per tonne of aluminium and says fewer than five Indian firms make it, with imports filling the gap (S3). NALCO itself ran a global tender for 2,520 t of low-bulk-density AlF3 in Jan 2026 (S21).

Announced smelter additions are about 1.3 Mtpa: Hindalco Aditya +3.6 lakh tpa (Rs 21,000 cr) (S6), NALCO Angul +0.5 Mtpa by early 2030 (S7)(S8), and BALCO's new smelter in ramp-up (S17)(S18). At 14-20 kg/t, that implies roughly 18-26 kt/yr of extra AlF3 demand (our arithmetic on S3).

Alufluoride (24,000 tpa since Jun 2026) saw Q1 FY27 sales fall to Rs 26.6 cr from Rs 43.8 cr on the FSA shortage (S3)(S4). On 23 Oct 2026 it traded at Rs 546, 22.1% below its 52-week high, with a market cap of Rs 427 cr and a P/E of 17.1 (S4). That compares with Rs 683 on 9 Oct (S20). Q2 FY27 results had not been published as of 23 Oct.

Paradeep Phosphates' Rs 250 cr, 15,000 tpa AlF3 plant (approved 28 Jul 2026) is guided to commission in 22-24 months, with Rs 180-200 cr revenue and at least Rs 50 cr EBITDA (S1)(S2). That revenue is under 1% of its TTM sales of Rs 23,447 cr (S14). The stock is at Rs 132, 27.1% below its 52-week high (S14).

FSA, not plant capacity, is the bottleneck. Paradeep said 70-75% of global sulphur and ammonia trade passes through Hormuz and it was running about 70% of phosphoric capacity (S1). Alufluoride scaled back operations in May 2026 for the same reason (S5).

for_investors.title: Who benefits
points: Alufluoride: the only qualified listed pure-play, supplying Hindalco, Vedanta and NALCO (S4) from 24,000 tpa of capacity (S3). Higher Chinese reference prices (S22) support import-parity pricing, but volumes depend on FSA.
Paradeep Phosphates: converts 9,000-10,000 tpa of low-value FSA into a non-subsidy product (S1). Strategically useful, but small against fertiliser earnings (S14).
NALCO and other smelters: a domestic JV or long-term partnership would cut reliance on imported AlF3 such as the 2,520 t it tendered for in Jan 2026 (S21).

for_investors.title: Who is hurt / risks
points: Alufluoride buys part of its FSA from Paradeep Phosphates 'as available' (S3). Paradeep plans to use its own HFSA in its AlF3 plant (S1), so this source is likely to disappear around 2028.
FSA output depends on phosphoric acid run rates, which were hit by the 2026 Hormuz disruption to sulphur and ammonia (S1)(S5).
Customer concentration: Alufluoride's largest customer was 69.27% of its FY25 AlF3 revenue (S3).

for_investors.title: What to watch
points: NALCO EoI submissions close 30 Oct 2026. Watch for any shortlist, RFP or JV announcement after that (S21)(S23).
Alufluoride Q2 FY27 results: whether volumes recovered toward last year's level, as management expected (S3).
Paradeep Q2 FY27 results (due by 14 Nov 2026 under the 45-day rule) (S24) for AlF3 engineering and ordering progress (S1).

sections.title: What AlF3 is and how the fertiliser by-product route works

subsections.title: The product, demand driver and price reference

blocks.text: Aluminium fluoride is added to the cryolite bath in aluminium electrolysis to lower its melting point and increase conductivity (S10). Alufluoride says 14-20 kg of AlF3 is used per tonne of aluminium. It describes the Indian market as supplied by fewer than five domestic makers plus imports, and says only a few can supply high-purity, low-bulk-density material to the major smelters (S3). AlF3 is therefore a consumable whose volume rises in line with primary aluminium output.

Import data is thin and comes from secondary sources. OEC data for 2022 lists India as the world's second-largest importer of aluminium fluoride, at about USD 82.3 mn (S19). NALCO's Jan 2026 global tender for 2,520 t of low-bulk-density AlF3 is a recent sign of import reliance (S21). We found no official 2025-26 import volume and no DGTR anti-dumping case on AlF3.

blocks.caption: China AlF3 reference prices (SMM, yuan/t)
rows: October contracts settled more than 1,000 yuan/t higher; tight spot supply; losses narrowing

blocks.text: The rise in China's price is driven by costs. Fluorite is firm, and mine operating rates are low because of environmental and safety inspections (S22). It is not a demand boom. Firmer Chinese prices make imports into India less of a threat in the near term.

subsections.title: The FSA route and its bottleneck

blocks.text: In the wet route, aluminium hydroxide is reacted with hydrofluosilicic acid (FSA/HFSA), the silica is filtered out, and the AlF3 is crystallised and dried (S10). FSA is a by-product of phosphoric acid made at phosphate fertiliser plants, so AlF3 supply depends on fertiliser operating rates (S3)(S5).

items: Paradeep Phosphates makes about 9,000-10,000 tpa of FSA today and sells all of it to outside parties (S1).

Alufluoride's FSA supply: an IFFCO Paradeep contract above 17,500 tpa (expandable to 19,000 tpa), about 4,500 tpa from Coromandel's Visakhapatnam and Kakinada plants, and Paradeep Phosphates 'as available' (S3).

In 2026, West Asia hostilities disrupted sulphur and ammonia supply through Hormuz, which constrained FSA output. Alufluoride scaled back operations in May 2026 (S5). Paradeep said it was running about 70% of phosphoric capacity (S1).

blocks.text: Vedanta's wider plan is to reach about 3.1 Mtpa of aluminium capacity by FY28, at a reported cost of Rs 13,226 cr, according to Outlook Business citing sources (S18). In Q1 FY27, BALCO produced 168 kt, up 16.7% year on year (S17).

subsections.title: Domestic AlF3 supply additions and NALCO's EoI

blocks.caption: Announced Indian AlF3 capacity moves
rows: New AlF3 plant at Paradeep, Rs 250 cr
JV / long-term partnership EoI for HBD and LBD AlF3 (plus CPC, coal-tar pitch)

blocks.text: NALCO's AlF3 EoI (reference NALCO/BD/ST/2026/5805, reported as dated 21 Sep 2026) seeks either an equity JV, preferably near the Angul smelter, or a long-term partnership tied to assured offtake. Responses will be used for shortlisting ahead of a detailed RFP or JV talks (S23). SMM dates the invitation 18 Sep, so the issue date differs between sources (S21). Earlier reporting set the specifications: HBD AlF3 of at least 90% purity and 1.3 g/cc bulk density, and LBD AlF3 of at least 95% and 0.75 g/cc, plus access to FSA or alumina hydrate (S9).

On paper, the new supply (+6 kt Alufluoride, +15 kt Paradeep) roughly matches the 18-26 kt of implied new demand. But both depend on FSA from the same few east-coast phosphoric acid plants (S1)(S3). Feedstock, not plant capacity, is the binding limit.

Alufluoride's sales grew from Rs 88 cr in FY22 to Rs 209 cr in FY26, with operating margins of 16-22% (S4). In FY25 it produced a record 16,377 t and dispatched 15,831 t (S3). Q1 FY27 sales fell 39.3% year on year to Rs 26.6 cr on the FSA disruption, taking TTM sales to Rs 192 cr and PAT to Rs 25 cr (S4). Its shares were admitted to NSE trading on 17 Aug 2026 (S4). The largest customer was 69.27% of FY25 AlF3 revenue (S3).

SPIC's 'Greenstar' AlF3 (ALF-96) is made by the FSA-alumina hydrate route. Its named customers are Hindalco, Dubal, Stella and Foundry Service (S10). SPIC does not disclose AlF3 capacity or revenue. It is mainly a urea maker, with TTM sales of Rs 3,024 cr (S11). Tanfac lists AlF3 among its HF-derived products (S12). Its Rs 495 cr expansion is mainly a Rs 405 cr, 20,000 t HFC-32 refrigerant plant, not AlF3 (S13). Neither company discloses AlF3 as a material earnings line.

Paradeep's guidance implies about Rs 1.2-1.33 lakh/t realisation (Rs 180-200 cr on 15,000 t; our arithmetic from S1). That is close to Alufluoride's FY25 blended revenue of about Rs 1.19 lakh per tonne dispatched (our arithmetic from S3 and S4, including by-products). Management targets at least 20% of EBITDA from non-subsidy businesses over time (S1). The AlF3 plant remains small next to Q1 FY27 revenue of Rs 6,124 cr and PAT of Rs 393 cr (S1).

Coromandel International supplies about 4,500 tpa of FSA to Alufluoride (S3). It has announced no AlF3 plant. With a market cap of about Rs 51,038 cr (S25), any AlF3 move would be immaterial to its earnings. NALCO's market cap is about Rs 54,851 cr, with TTM PAT of Rs 6,751 cr (S15), so an AlF3 JV would be about supply security, not earnings (S7)(S23).

sections.title: Research house views and market positioning

items: We again found no broker or mainstream media report grouping these stocks as an 'AlF3 theme'. Coverage is company-by-company, and trade press (SMM, AlCircle) covers the NALCO EoI (S2)(S21)(S23).

Paradeep rose 14.54% intraday to Rs 159.50 on 29 Jul 2026 after Q1 results and the AlF3 approval (S2). It now trades at Rs 132, 27.1% below its 52-week high (S14). The post-announcement gain has fully reversed.

Alufluoride fell from Rs 683 on 9 Oct (S20) to Rs 546 on 23 Oct, 22.1% below its 52-week high (S4). This corrects last week's view that the stock had not retraced. We found no news explaining the fall, and Q2 FY27 results are pending.

On Paradeep's Q1 FY27 call, analysts from Elara Securities, Aequitas, HDFC AMC and others asked about AlF3 timing, realisation and grade. Management said the plant would target Odisha smelters and would need no qualification period (S1). This is management's view, not independently verified.
FSA shortage: Alufluoride's Q1 FY27 sales fell 39% year on year when West Asia disruption cut feedstock (S4)(S5).
Supplier turning competitor: Paradeep supplies FSA to Alufluoride (S3) but plans to use its own HFSA in-house (S1).
Price: China's rise is cost-driven, on fluorite and inspection-related mine curbs (S22). If fluorite eases, Chinese AlF3 and imports could get cheaper.
Concentration: Alufluoride's top customer was 69% of FY25 AlF3 revenue (S3), and demand is tied to three smelter groups (S4).
Project slippage: NALCO's earlier expansion plans were repeatedly delayed (S8). Its new smelter targets early 2030 (S7), and the AlF3 EoI deadline has already been extended once (S21).
Liquidity: Alufluoride's market cap is about Rs 427 cr (S4), and only 3.17k shares traded on 9 Oct 2026 (S20).
NALCO EoI close on 30 Oct 2026, then a shortlist, RFP or JV announcement (S21)(S23).
Alufluoride Q2 FY27 results: a test of whether volumes recover toward last year's level (S3)(S4).
Paradeep Q2 FY27 results, due by 14 Nov 2026 (S24): AlF3 engineering and ordering, and the phosphoric acid expansion to 6 lakh t by Dec 2026, which adds HFSA (S1).
China's November AlF3 contract settlement, a pointer to import parity (S22).
BALCO reaching full ramp-up by Q4 FY27 (S17), and Hindalco disclosing an Aditya construction timetable (S6).
Any DGTR or customs action on AlF3 imports. None was found as of this edition.

companies.name: Alufluoride Ltd
companies.role: India's largest maker of low-bulk-density AlF3, qualified at Hindalco, Vedanta and NALCO (S4). It converts fertiliser FSA into AlF3 at Visakhapatnam, with 24,000 tpa installed (S3).
companies.impact: The most direct play on smelter growth and firmer China reference prices (S22), but FSA-constrained. Q1 FY27 sales were Rs 26.6 cr vs Rs 43.8 cr (S4). The stock is 22% off its high ahead of Q2 results (S4). A natural candidate for NALCO's EoI, though no respondents have been disclosed (S21).

companies.name: Southern Petrochemicals Industries Corporation (SPIC)
companies.role: Makes Greenstar ALF-96 AlF3 by the FSA route and supplies Hindalco, Dubal and others (S10). Mainly a urea maker (S11).
companies.impact: AlF3 capacity and revenue are undisclosed. Against TTM sales of Rs 3,024 cr (S11), it is unlikely to be a meaningful earnings driver on current evidence.

companies.name: Tanfac Industries Ltd
companies.role: HF-based fluorochemicals maker whose products include aluminium fluoride (S12).
companies.impact: Growth is driven by HF and a Rs 405 cr HFC-32 plant (S13), not AlF3. The stock trades at about 104x earnings (S12), so the AlF3 theme is marginal for it.

companies.name: Paradeep Phosphates Ltd
companies.role: DAP/NPK maker producing 9,000-10,000 tpa of FSA. It is building a Rs 250 cr, 15,000 tpa AlF3 plant (S1)(S2).
companies.impact: Guided Rs 180-200 cr revenue and at least Rs 50 cr EBITDA once commissioned in about 22-24 months (S1). That is under 1% of TTM sales of Rs 23,447 cr (S14). A possible NALCO partner given its Odisha location and FSA, but unconfirmed (S1)(S23).

companies.name: Coromandel International Ltd
companies.role: Supplies about 4,500 tpa of FSA to Alufluoride from its Visakhapatnam and Kakinada phosphoric acid plants (S3).
companies.impact: An FSA supplier only. No AlF3 plant has been announced. With a market cap of about Rs 51,038 cr (S25), AlF3 would be immaterial unless it follows Paradeep (S3).

companies.name: National Aluminium Company Ltd (NALCO)
companies.role: Smelter with 4.6 lakh t capacity (S8), adding 0.5 Mtpa at Angul by early 2030 (S7). It is seeking AlF3 JV or partnership proposals through an EoI, with the deadline extended to 30 Oct 2026 (S21).
companies.impact: Supply security rather than earnings. A JV would be small against TTM PAT of Rs 6,751 cr (S15). It still tenders for imported AlF3 (S21).

companies.name: Hindalco Industries Ltd
companies.role: AlF3 buyer from Alufluoride and SPIC (S4)(S10). Adding a 3.6 lakh tpa smelter at Aditya (S6).
companies.impact: Implies about 5-7 kt/yr of extra AlF3 demand (our calc on S3, S6). No captive AlF3 plan found.

companies.name: Vedanta Ltd
companies.role: AlF3 customer of Alufluoride (S4). Ramping up the new BALCO smelter (S17) toward about 3.1 Mtpa group capacity by FY28 (S18).
companies.impact: The nearest-term demand addition, with BALCO at full ramp by Q4 FY27 (S17). No captive AlF3 plan found.

method: Weekly refresh of the 2026-W42 edition, researched on 23-24 Oct 2026 with web search and direct page fetches. New this week: (1) SMM (S21) reports that NALCO extended its AlF3/CPC/coal-tar-pitch EoIs to 30 Oct 2026, correcting last week's 'closed 12 Oct'. (2) SMM's 22 Oct fluoride salt review (S22) shows China AlF3 at 12,600-13,000 yuan/t after October contracts rose more than 1,000 yuan/t. (3) Market data was refreshed from numbers.json (screener.in, 23 Oct 2026); it shows Alufluoride 22% below its 52-week high, which corrects last week's 'not retraced' reading. AlCircle (S23) and Univest (S24) were seen only in search results because the pages blocked fetching or were not opened; their details (EoI reference number and structure, 14 Nov results deadline) are attributed and treated as secondary. The Prabhudas Lilladher note on Paradeep (31 Jul 2026) could not be text-extracted and is not used. No Q2 FY27 results for Alufluoride or Paradeep were published as of 23 Oct. Carried-forward facts from company documents (S1, S3, S6, S10) are unchanged disclosures and were not re-fetched this week. Implied AlF3 demand and realisation figures are our own arithmetic and are labelled as such. Market-cap coverage: small caps (Alufluoride, SPIC), mid caps (Tanfac, Paradeep) and large caps (Coromandel, NALCO, Hindalco, Vedanta). Searches for AlF3 plans at other fertiliser or fluorochemical makers (FACT, GSFC, Gujarat Fluorochemicals, Navin Fluorine) found nothing qualifying, so the pure-play universe is effectively one stock. Not verified: NALCO EoI respondents, AlF3 revenue shares for SPIC and Tanfac, Hindalco's commissioning date, 2025-26 India import volumes, and the brief's six-month and one-year return figures. No ratings or price targets.
